title: a merge regenerates the plans of everyone in the families it joins
line: the file's two entries for Thomas Ahearn, each Alice McGee's husband: her plan asks for the marriage record once per husband; merged, the second's family folds into the first's and inside the merge her plan asks once, never left for the next plan run; and the 1940 household's daughter, merged into its son as an older merge left her, her membership of her parents' family beside his: the merge run again folds it, and inside it her mother Helen Sara Brant's plan is regenerated with his

steps.say: Alice McGee's plan as the file leaves it: the marriage record cited for her is a step once per husband, both named Thomas Ahearn
the owner merges the second entry into the first

merge.note: harness: the file's two entries for one man

expect.why: the second's family with her folds into the first's
one husband now: her plan, regenerated inside the merge, asks for the marriage record once

steps.say: the 1940 page arrives through the inbox: a card for each of the four it names
the rule takes the daughter's card
the daughter merged into the son as an older merge left it: her membership of her parents' family beside his

merge.note: harness: two children of one family merged, as one child entered twice under the same parents would be

expect.why: her mother's plan as the older merge left it

steps.say: the merge run again on the pair completes it

expect.why: the fold changes her parents' family: her mother's plan is regenerated inside the merge, not only the kept son's
